definitions.gloss: to vanish; to disappear completely; to fade away entirely
definitions.explanation: To disappear without a trace. Stronger and more emphatic than simply 消える, implying complete and final disappearance.

examples.japanese: {不安|ふあん}が{消|き}え{去|さ}ることはなかった。
あの{日|ひ}の{記憶|きおく}は{時間|じかん}とともに{消|き}え{去|さ}り、{今|いま}ではほとんど{思|おも}い{出|だ}せない。
examples.english: The memories of that day faded away with time, and now I can barely recall them.

notes: A compound verb formed from {消|き}える (to disappear) + {去|さ}る (to leave, to go away). The {去|さ}る component adds emphasis on the completeness and finality of the disappearance. Godan verb conjugation: {消|き}え{去|さ}らない (negative), {消|き}え{去|さ}った (past). Can be used for both physical things (fog, people) and abstract things (memories, feelings, pain). More literary in tone than {消|き}える alone.
